title: LoRa / Meshtastic / LoRaWAN: five nodes and a relay
description: A 2.4 MHz scene around 921.8 MHz (NZ ANZ band): Meshtastic text !a1b2c3d4 'ZL hello mesh' (60 deg, SF11 BW250, public default channel), a Meshtastic POSITION !deadbeef (300 deg, SF9 BW250), a Meshtastic NODEINFO 'Wellington Hill' !11223344 (160 deg, SF11), a relayed copy of !a1b2c3d4 (230 deg, hop_start!=hop_limit, attributed to the relay node !relay-44), a private-channel Meshtastic !000000aa (100 deg, header only - not decrypted), and a LoRaWAN uplink DevAddr 26011F88 (20 deg, SF9 BW125, clear MAC header only). Expect the Meshtastic nodes at their bearings; the LoRaWAN and relay by bearing.
